fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-03-16, the seller of a house near Kalai Colony Apartment Complex allegedly accepted Rs. 15,000 from the complainant without a clear title. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-03-13 at approximately 11:45. Jagan Anand (mobile 9000000165) was named as a possible person of interest. A further person, Arun Muthu, a driver, using the number 9000000304, is stated to be associated with the incident. Nithin Thangaraj (9000000252) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. No supporting material was reported at the time of registration.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Seller reportedly shared questionable documents and stopped responding.
fields.Keywords: property fraud, cheating, mobile number, suspect, associate, morning, apartment complex, witness
